notes.title: Update ver13.4
notes.notes:
UPDATE
HP bars of some enemies have been improved to be more visible.
Fixed a bug that prevented scores from being recorded in the rankings under certain conditions.
Changed the ranking so that only endless mode boards are recorded.
The previous rankings will remain as Season 1.




Balance adjustment
The HP of tank-type enemies including bosses has been reduced.
Removed gravity resistance of non-boss enemies.
Weakened gravity resistance of bosses.
Weakened homing projectiles of almost all enemies.
Increased the amount of money obtained for defeating bosses.

notes.title: Development Progress Toward Production Version Update
notes.notes:
We are preparing to update the product version.

and more.

notes.title: Update Version 8.0 !
notes.notes:
[h2]Update Details[/h2]
[h3]New system: Item recycling implemented[/h3]
[list]
[*] This is a system to batch convert items in one's possession into other items of the same rarity.
[*] The system can be used by approaching a recycle box dropped by a boss or unique enemy.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Adjustment[/h2]

A cap has been placed on the rate of fire of weapons that appear with the Arc skill.
→Shotguns are now limited to 15/s (10 rate increase items)
→All others are 25/s.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

The following bugs have been fixed

[list]
[*] A bug that caused the player's shooting sound to be omitted
[*] Bug that the effect of the Uncommon Item Overkill Explosion was not properly activated.
[*] Some bugs related to grapple skills
[*] Bug in which the torso of the ship does not become transparent
[*] Bug that the effects of the player's sniper rounds were unnatural.
[/list]

Optimization-related

The following loads have been reduced
[list]
[*] Player bullets
[*] Fire Barrettes
[*] Arc skill bullets and effects
[*] Attribute Effects
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 7.6
notes.notes:
[h2]Update Details[/h2]

Added information on new items to the Data tab.


[h2]Balance Adjustment[/h2]

[list]
[*] Lowered the jumping power of the High Jump skill in the air.
[*] Lowered the blowing up power of explosions by 25%.
[*] The power of Spirit of Fire [Legendary] has been increased too much, so the base damage has been capped. (Each time you use an action skill during the effect duration, the power will increase up to 10 times.)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

The following bugs have been fixed.

[list]
[*] Bug where the High Jump skill would fly too high.
[*] Bug where your ship's body is not transparent when the camera is too close.
[*] Bug in which new items are not shown in the result.
[/list]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]

Reduced the load related to item textures.

notes.title: Mini Update v7.4(2022/1/19)

[h1]Update Contents[/h1].

Added a ☆ mark to the stage image to indicate the initial rank.
The result screen now shows the items you have acquired.
Added the names of those who have helped in the credits roll.
Added fast forward, rewind, and pause buttons to the credits roll.
Added an effect when the STEGOROBO-Smasher (guarded enemy) guards.

notes.title: Update Version7.3(2022/1/3)
notes.notes:
頂いたフィードバックの反映などがメインです。

[h3]アップデート内容[/h3]

プレイ中、画面右上に表示される｢難易度｣を｢ランク｣という呼び方に変更しました。
[list]
[*] ｢Easy・Normal・Hard｣の難易度と混同していたため。
[/list]

アイテムセレクターに近づいたとき、取得できるアイテムの名前が表示されるようになりました。
近接系のAIを改善しました。
チュートリアルを改善しました。
Winganoid型の敵が一定条件でその場に停止してストーム攻撃を行うように変更しました。


[h3]バランス調整[/h3]

緑色アイテム「Poison」の効果が全ての攻撃に適用されていたのを弾丸にのみ適用するように変更しました。
敵のホーミング弾の弾速上昇に上限を設けました。
緑色アイテム「シールドボム」の効果を変更しました。
[list]
[*] グレネードドロップ数の上限を3に設定(ただしミラーグレネードの効果で上限を超えているように見える場合があります。)
[*] スタックの数だけ威力が+100されるようにしました。
[/list]

Crunch型の敵のホーミング弾(地面を這ってくる攻撃)の弾速が上がらないようにしました。
SpiderBossのストーム攻撃の持続時間を短くしました。
Tank型(戦車型で高HP)の敵の移動速度を上げました。
Spider型の敵の移動速度を下げました。
Bike型(3輪)の敵の移動速度を下げました。
Wheel型(6輪)の敵の移動速度を下げました。
Wheel型の敵がときどき足を止めるように変更しました。
STEGOROBO(人型近接)の移動速度を上げました。
STEGOROBO-Kickerのユニーク(強化個体)のステップ速度を上げました。


[h3]バグ修正[/h3]
Crunch型の敵のホーミング弾(地面を這ってくる攻撃)の不自然な挙動を修正しました。

[h3]最適化関連[/h3]

以下の負荷を軽減しました。

[list]
[*] Boom!(ドカン！)で発生する爆発エフェクト
[*] ボス敵のマズルフラッシュエフェクト
[*] シールドボムの効果によるグレネード
[/list]

notes.title: Big Update v7.1( 23 Dec.2021)
notes.notes:
v7.1

[h1]Update Details[/h1]

Implemented slow barrettes.
The bullet speed of some enemies has been slowed down considerably.
→The game is now more like a bullet hell game.

Added enemy characters
Added boss characters

New stage "Isolated Island" implemented.

[h1]Optimization[/h1]
Lightened the load of enemy bullets
Lightened explosion effects


[h1]Balance adjustment, etc.[/h1]
Lowered the bullet speed of sniper-type enemies.
Enemy bullet speed increase by rank has been capped.
→Enemies no longer fire invisible, ultra-high speed bullets.
Increased the rate at which enemies' attack power increases with rank.
Increased the attack power of Unique Enemies (purple).

The "Hot Time" skill has been enhanced so that the rate of fire will not decrease while in use. (Under the current specifications, it is necessary to press the fire button again after activating the skill.)
Reduced the maximum HP of low rank bosses by approximately 60%. Changed so that the maximum HP of bosses increases as they reach higher ranks.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Fixed a bug where drone-type enemies did not spawn initially.
